name: serve an api bound to all interfaces on a fixed port in the background
definition: Run the app so it listens on the required port and is reachable via localhost and the container network.
failure_mode: server not running, wrong host binding, or not backgrounded makes it unreachable

name: solve an interactive JSON maze over HTTP, finishing exactly at the exit
definition: Interact with a JSON maze service and call the finish endpoint only in the exit cell.
failure_mode: finishing too early permanently marks the game failed

name: start a long-lived dependent server process and wait for readiness
definition: Launch the game server, monitor startup until a readiness signal, and keep it reachable for client connections.
failure_mode: Client incompatible with the server's actual protocol times out.

name: start and keep daemons running for the testing session
definition: Launch SSH and web daemons so they remain responsive when the verifier runs after setup ends.
failure_mode: Services that stop when the setup shell exits cause the fetch/panel to fail.
